notes.title: April 5th - Minor Patch notes
notes.notes:
A second launch patch that addresses a few other issues.

-Fixed chapter 8 completion achievement not triggering
-Fixed the Spring Loaded achievement not triggering
-Fixed the final Tendril Relic achievement not triggering
-Extra SFX
-Reduced pipe water strength in Chapter 5
-One way platform visual consistency
-Adjusted difficulty of chapter 4 screen
-Fixed a music softlock in chapter 7
-Chapter 6 enemy ai bug fixes

notes.title: April 5th - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

This patch addresses most launch day issues.

-Civilian in chapter 3 can no longer be re-triggered
-Chapter 4 vertical screens are less difficult
-Chapter 3 cutscene skip fixes
-Chapter 3 handle visibility improvements
-Chapter 6 handle visibility improvements
-Chapter 2 music transitional fixes
-Chapter 4 potential softlock removed
-Chapter 7 music fixes
-Unobtainable relic in Chapter 7 now obtainable
-More checkpoints in chapters 6, 7 and 8
-Reduced difficulty of some chapter 3 screens
-Increased size of gaps in early chapter 8 screens
-Unobtainable relic in Chapter 8 now obtainable
-Reduced strength of fan wind in chapter 8
-Reduced difficulty of boss fight in chapter 8
-Reduced RNG elements of boss fight in chapter 8
-Removed potential room skip in chapter 6
-Minor SFX additions

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Vindefiant is out now!
notes.notes:
Vindefiant is officially out on Steam! 

Thank you for all the amazing support, and here's to launch day!

Time to cause chaos and get your vengeance.

notes.title: Vindefiant releases on April 4th!
notes.notes:
Vindefiant officially drops on Steam on [b]April 4th![/b] Make sure to keep your eye on release day to grab yourself the game and begin your journey as Alyx. 

This has been a long journey to get here and I [i]cannot[/i] wait for you all to play! 

All the support on the game has been incredible, and I cannot understate how crucial it has been for supporting me as a developer. The support needed for Vindefiant on launch day is going to be absolutely essential.

I hope you're as excited as I am, and I'll see you soon.

notes.title: Vindefiant is joining PixElated Fest on July 29th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963588/1094d5a2bdb1e2b9b935f97700cece260a8c2276.png[/img]

Join us in celebrating pixel art games together 🎉 in the PixElated Festival starting on July 29th! We are very excited to have been chosen to be part of the Coming Soon section of the festival alongside so many other great pixel art games.

The PixElated festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: Vindefiant Announcement!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Vindefiant's Steam page! 

After nearly a year of daily development, Vindefiant is now available to wishlist. 
I'll be posting frequent development updates about the game, as well as details regarding demos, events, and more.

Make sure to join the game's [url=https://vindefiantdisc.com/]Discord server[/url] to take part in playtests, giveaways, and more.

Find us on all [url=https://twitter.com/vindefiantGame]social medias[/url] under @vindefiantgame


Thanks to all the great messages about the game so far, and don't forget to wishlist!
